description: Create a spreadsheet to calculate the payback period for a home energy efficiency upgrade. You are evaluating a $8,500 window replacement investment. Current monthly energy bill: $185. Expected reduction after upgrade: 30%. Create the following structure: In A1 enter 'Current Monthly Bill', in B1 enter 185. In A2 enter 'Reduction Percentage', in B2 enter 0.30. In A3 enter 'New Monthly Bill', in B3 create formula =B1*(1-B2) to calculate the reduced bill. In A4 enter 'Monthly Savings', in B4 create formula =B1-B3 to calculate savings. In A5 enter 'Upgrade Cost', in B5 enter 8500. In A6 enter 'Payback Period (months)', in B6 create formula =B5/B4 to calculate how many months until the investment pays for itself. Save the file as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/energy_upgrade_analysis.xlsx using Ctrl+S.
